## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2 / −1.2×10¹² (nominal, run-5 calibration)

Raw R(B) first (ν labels at the nominal density), then `sdh_fft` in three windows and `sdh_onset` per-tone tracks.

**Read.** *Run 6 (electron, n_nom +3.2):* deep QH minima (Rxx ≤ 2 Ω) from ~1.8 to 7.2 T, then a 500 Ω maximum above 8 T. Tones at **7.1–7.4, 14.1–14.6, 22.2–22.3, 29.5–29.6 T**. The deep minima are spaced by ≈ 0.034 T⁻¹ in 1/B, i.e. period ~29.6 T, vs the nominal F_L = 33.1 T → the absolute n scale (c_tg anchored to the 9.5 nm prior) reads **~0.90× nominal**. This is tentative; the fan's QH-minima slopes will calibrate it. **22.2 T is not behaving like the 3rd harmonic of 7.1 T:** it is the strongest tone (SNR 101, onset 1.33 T), stronger and earlier than 14.1 T (SNR 50, onset 1.62 T). A harmonic ladder has to weaken with order. Also 7.3 + 22.3 ≈ 29.6 T, the full-density period. That is the two-pocket, sum-to-F_L pattern of ABAB's light/heavy bilayer-like bands. It is not the single-band ABCA pattern, which predicts no independent ~7 T pocket at this density. Region B (series mosaic, +0.43×10¹²) would add tones near ×1.13, not a 7 T tone. *Run 7 (hole, n_nom −1.2):* minima don't reach zero. The spectrum is a broad 5–8 T cluster (tones 4.7 / 6.6 / 8.5 / 9.4 T) plus 12.3 T (SNR 124, onset 1.6 T) ≈ F_L. The cluster is unresolved at dF ≥ 1.1 T: preview only.

**Take:** lean **ABAB, weak**. One density only, and 22.3 ≈ 3 × 7.4 is an unbroken coincidence here. The discriminator is how the tones move with n: independent bands drift apart in ratio, harmonics stay locked at k·F1. That is plan step 4, the D = 0 Landau fan.

# Runs 6-7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (sdh-spot-check). Raw R(B) first, then FFT windows + per-tone onsets.
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_fft, sdh_onset
h_e = cst.h / cst.e
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 7.5))
for k, (rid, n_nom) in enumerate([(6, 3.2), (7, -1.2)]):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I)
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    nuF = abs(n_nom) * 1e16 * h_e          # nu = nuF / B at the nominal (run-5, prior-anchored) density
    print(f"run {rid}: n_nom {n_nom:+.1f}e12 (F_L nominal {nuF/4:.1f} T); B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, R {R.min():.0f}-{R.max():.0f} Ohm "
          f"(sr1 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS -> max {R.max()/5000:.0%}), T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K")
    ax[k, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[k, 0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[k, 0].set_ylabel("Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    for b_ in (2, 4, 6, 8, 10): ax[k, 0].text(b_, R.max() * 1.02, f"nu {nuF/b_:.0f}", fontsize=7, ha="center")
    ax[k, 0].set_title(f"run {rid} raw, n_nom {n_nom:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    for lo, hi in [(1.0, 4.0), (1.5, 6.0), (1.0, 10.0)]:
        f, S = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, hi), nfft=1024, bg_degree=3, log=False)
        sel = (f > 2) & (f < 60); ax[k, 1].plot(f[sel], S[0, sel] / S[0, sel].max(), lw=0.9, label=f"B [{lo}, {hi}] T  dF {1/(1/lo-1/hi):.1f} T")
    ax[k, 1].axvline(nuF / 4, color="k", ls=":", label="F_L nominal"); ax[k, 1].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[k, 1].legend(fontsize=7)
    ax[k, 1].set_title(f"run {rid} sdh_fft (linear R, deg-3 B-space bg)")
    try:
        print(sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.3, r_full_scale=5000).summary())
    except Exception as e:
        print("sdh_onset:", e)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n −1.20 → +3.20×10¹² × B 1 → 10 T

> **05:25** · landau-fan D=0: n -1.20..+3.20e12 (89 pts, Vtg -0.277..+0.984, Vbg -0.465..+1.166) x B 1->10 T (91 rows uniform 1/B, F\_nyq 50 T, dF 1.1 T), fast\_delay 1 s, sr1 50 uV, Vsi 0, T base; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~09:45** (≈4h20m)

Plan step 4 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`), requested by the operator as the stacking fan. **What the spot checks left open** (ana, runs 6–7): at n_nom = +3.2 the tones are 7.3 / 14.6 / 22.3 / 29.6 T. The 22.3 T tone is stronger and sets in earlier than 14.6 T, so it breaks the harmonic hierarchy and is likely an independent band. Also 7.3 + 22.3 ≈ 29.6 T, the QH-zero period. That is the ABAB two-band pattern, **but only weakly**: 22.3 ≈ 3 × 7.4 at that one density. The fan decides it by **tracking the tones with n**. Independent bands keep F1 + F2 = F_L(n) while their ratio drifts; harmonics stay locked at exactly k·F1. The (n, B) map also shows whether the Landau levels form one ladder (ABCA) or two crossing ladders (ABAB). It shows the region-B ladder (series mosaic, converging at n_A ≈ −0.43), and the QH-minima slopes give the absolute n scale. Run 6 suggests that scale is ~0.90× the 9.5 nm prior.

**Design.** Fast axis: (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the run-5 D = 0 line, n = −1.20 → +3.20×10¹² in 0.05 steps (89 pts). The endpoints are exactly the run 6/7 spot gate points (V_tg −0.277 / +0.984 V), already exercised with no leakage. Slow axis: B 1.0 → 10.0 T, 91 rows **uniform in 1/B** (Δ(1/B) = 0.01 T⁻¹ → F_nyq 50 T, which keeps the 2×F_L alias off the 0–35 T band; resolution dF = 1.1 T). The magnet sits at 0 T, so the fan ramps up and **ends at 10 T** for a later ride-down, with no re-traverse. Dwell: fast_delay 1 s ≈ 3.3 τ (τ 0.3 s / 24 dB), the same as gatemap run 5. That gives a uniform ~1-step lag in n, the same direction every row, which is correctable and doesn't touch the 1/B FFT. slow_delay 3 s after each flyback (10 τ). Sensitivity is fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS), the runs 6/7 setting (maxima 11–12 % FS at 10 T).

**Coverage trade:**
- D = 0 only. ±D is conditional plan step 5, sized after this read.
- n is TG-limited at both ends; the hole side stops at −1.2.
- B starts at 1.0 T rather than 0.8 T. Going to 0.8 T would add 25 rows / ~50 min for dF 0.87 T vs 1.1 T.
- The CNP / ν = 0 columns may rail at high B. That's accepted: they are not FFT evidence.

**Price** (run 5: 1.10 s/pt in-row + 5.8 s turnaround; run 6: 3.1 s settle overhead; 10 T bare ramp 73 min): 91 × (89 × 1.15 + 9) s ≈ 2.8 h + 1.2 h ramp → **≈ 4 h 20 m** realistic. Guards interrupt on |I_gate| > 1 nA or T_sample > 3 K; gates park at 0 on any exit, and the field holds.

**Checkpoints:**
- **First rows** (rows 0–3, B ≈ 1.00–1.03 T, ~15 min in). R(n) should match runs 6/7 at 1 T: ~10–20 Ω at n = +3.2, ~100–150 Ω at n = −1.2, and the CNP peak ~300 Ω near n ≈ 0 with the region-B shoulder near −0.43. Also check: no rail, I_drain ≈ 9.9 nA, gate currents at their pA offsets. Abort on a rail, a dead channel, or leakage.
- **Row ~45** (1.8 T, ~1 h 40 m in): partial FFT of the landed rows for F1(n). Continue if the light tone tracks n.
- **Row ~70** (3.3 T, ~2 h 35 m in): F1(n) and F2(n) tracks, plus QH-minima lines for the lever arm.
- Full analysis at completion.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), plan step 4: B slow 1 -> 10 T (91 rows, uniform in 1/B) x n fast -1.20 -> +3.20e12 (89 pts, D = 0 co-swept) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, abs. scale = 9.5 nm prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.round(np.linspace(-1.20, 3.20, 89), 4)                      # 1e12 cm^-2, 0.05 step
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
_n_chk, _D_chk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.allclose(_n_chk, n_vec, atol=1e-6) and np.abs(_D_chk).max() < 1e-6
B_vec = np.round(field_invB(1.0, 10.0, 91), 5)                         # uniform in 1/B: d(1/B) = 0.01 T^-1 -> F_nyq 50 T, dF 1.1 T
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
print(f"fast: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts) | Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V, "
      f"Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V (limits TG [{TG_MIN},{TG_MAX}] BG [{BG_MIN},{BG_MAX}])")
print(f"slow: B {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {len(B_vec)} rows uniform in 1/B (dB {B_vec[1]-B_vec[0]:.4f} T at 1 T, {B_vec[-1]-B_vec[-2]:.3f} T at 10 T)")

# --- preconditions (state this cell assumes but does not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _Tv, _B0 = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vap = {_Tv:.3f} K (< 2), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
print(f"precondition drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency()} Hz (1.0 V -> 10 nA), sr1 tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB (0.3 / 24)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and _Tv < 2.0 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-3 and sr1.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0   # 1 s = 3.3 tau (uniform ~1-step lag in n, same direction every row); 3 s after flyback = 10 tau
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 3.0
# Fixed sensitivity (no mid-row autorange): 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA — the setting that resolved SdH in runs 6/7
# (max 530-590 Ohm at 10 T, 11-12 % FS). A rail at the CNP / nu = 0 columns at high B is accepted (not FFT evidence).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (5 kOhm FS), sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D = 0: B slow 1 -> 10 T (91 rows, uniform 1/B) x n fast -1.20 -> +3.20e12 (89 pts, D = 0, run-5 cal), "
                  f"sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 1 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 V/nm; n fast {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 (89 pts, 0.05 step; Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, '
              f'Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f}); B slow 1.0 -> 10.0 T, 91 rows uniform in 1/B (d(1/B) = 0.01); '
              f'cal run 5: c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e}, c_bg {CAL["c_bg"]:.3e}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; Vsi 0; T base')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, magnet_field, Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', magnet.field)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, T = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), float(data[4])
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if T > T_TRIP:
        print(f"T TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T: T_sample = {T:.3f} K > {T_TRIP} K")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)   # gates parked at 0; field stays where the fan left it (10 T on completion)
    print(f"end: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample {T_sample():.3f} K")
